title: California Beach Towns and Celebrity Homes Private Flexible Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Travel time is included on total duration of the tour.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Flexible & Customizable. Choose a day in Santa Barbara, San Diego, or just sit back and relax as we drive you down the Pacific Coast Highway along the beautiful Southern California coastline through its scenic and charming coastal towns from Laguna Beach all the way up to Malibu in a private and luxurious SUV for your small group of up to 6 passengers. The flexible tour allows you to choose your break and lunch stops in various towns or ask your driver to choose for you. Your driver will provide dining suggestions if desired and show you a glimpse of some of the most famous celebrity homes as well.
